text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 10, 2024) for 186 Danforth Road.

The Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 10, 2024) for 186 Danforth Road, Folder Number 24 223559 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
